parts.text: Which brands can you use for deck generation? List them.
Available brands include Stripe, Apple, Airbnb, Spotify, Vercel, Slack, Starbucks and Tesla, each with a short description of its visual style.
I need a deck for our engineering all-hands next month.
Generate a 2-slide deck titled 'Cloud Cost Savings' for platform engineers. Goal: secure budget sign-off for FinOps tooling. Use Stripe branding. All details are set, go straight to generation.
